europe_now.title: EU Funding for Ukraine Military Aid
europe_now.summary: The European Union has released €6.6 billion to member states providing military support to Ukraine amid ongoing deadly attacks.

europe_now.title: EU Regulatory Fine on X
europe_now.summary: The European Union maintains its commitment to pursue a €120 million regulatory fine against platform X following US intervention.

top_stories.title: Pope Leo XIV's Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in France for a high-profile state visit, drawing large crowds during processions and visiting major landmarks. The pontiff participated in significant public engagements, including addresses and religious services in Paris.

top_stories.title: German Student Protests Over Military Service
top_stories.summary: Students across Germany organized widespread strikes and demonstrations to voice their opposition to compulsory military service. The protests highlight growing domestic tensions regarding national defense policy changes and youth mobilization.

europe_now.title: EU Releases Billions for Ukraine Defense
europe_now.summary: The European Union has unlocked 6.6 billion euros to support member states providing military equipment to Ukraine. This financial package coincides with reported attacks causing casualties in Kyiv and widening strikes against critical infrastructure.

europe_now.title: Pope Leo XIV Visits France
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo XIV is currently undertaking a high-profile visit to France, drawing massive crowds during his processions through Paris. His itinerary includes significant addresses at UNESCO and services held at Notre-Dame Cathedral.

top_stories.summary: Students across Germany have staged widespread strikes to voice their opposition to compulsory military service. The demonstrations highlight growing domestic pushback against recent shifts in regional security and defense policy.

top_stories.title: Polish Tax Rights Extension
top_stories.summary: Poland has officially expanded tax rights to include same-sex couples who entered into legal marriages abroad. This administrative change represents a notable shift in the country's recognition of foreign same-sex unions.

top_stories.title: EU Regulatory Fine on X
top_stories.summary: The European Union has affirmed its determination to pursue a substantial regulatory fine against the platform X. This enforcement action moves forward despite the United States expressing backing for the company's ongoing legal challenges.
